requiredFindings.title: The tree root the bootstrap path is relative to is not identified before the inventory exists
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The entrypoint is bin/opensip and the embedded bootstrap path is bootstrap, relative to a tree root the image does not locate. The producer treats the executable parent as that root and misses payload.json, or walks ancestors until a payload.json verifies and accepts the first signed tree. The kernel CodeDirectory join still passes.

requiredFindings.title: The platform row waits on InitialPlatform, which waits on this core
requiredFindings.failureScenario: InitialCore selects its inventory row by the InitialPlatform receipt, and InitialPlatform is defined to authenticate through the core. Neither receipt can be built. Selecting a row by scanning platforms for matching entrypoint bytes admits a platform id other than the anchor's platform field.
